note: Interaction rules: pairs of canonical rules that compose. Authored in Phase 5, not derived from Phase 4.

rules.statement: A status applied by a chart row with an until-end-of-next-turn duration survives the turn it was applied on and expires on the next.
A scene-duration status from a chart row survives every round boundary until the encounter ends.
Overcharge heat passes through the full damage pipeline: it can push the mech over its heat cap and trigger an overheating check in the same step.
Overcharge heat against an actor with no heat cap converts to energy damage rather than accumulating.
Bracing consumes the reaction for the turn and locks out reactions until the end of the next turn, so a second reaction cannot be taken in between.
A reaction spent before a character's first turn stays spent for that round and refreshes at the start of its turn in the next.
System Trauma never offers a weapon mod as a destruction target, and destroying a modded weapon destroys its mod with it.
A single hit crossing several structure points queues one check per point, each rolling against the running marked total.
A one-structure NPC is destroyed at 0 HP without rolling, so no chart row is ever selected for it.
A STUNNED mech cannot overcharge, and an overcharge already granted is lost rather than held.
PRONE implies SLOWED, so a prone character is denied BOOST for as long as it is prone.
SHREDDED removes armor and resistance from the damage order while leaving exposed doubling and vulnerability intact.
Every state a rule mutates is captured by the encounter snapshot, so undoing a structure check restores structure, HP, statuses, and pending checks together.
Damage to a mounted pilot lands on the mech, so the pilot cannot be brought DOWN AND OUT while their mech is intact.
An AI-controlled mech and its pilot draw from separate pools, so spending the mech's full action leaves the pilot's intact.
